title: A lazy, caching stand-in for slow documents

task.text: Connecting is slow and reading is slow, so do each as late and as rarely as possible.
Implement the **proxy** `CachedDocuments` in `Documents.java`. It is a `Documents`, built from a `Supplier<Documents>` factory.

items: Creating it must not call the factory; the first `read` does, once, even when many threads read at the same moment.
Reading an id that was read before returns the earlier reply without touching the real `Documents`.
Different ids each reach the real `Documents` once.
If the real read throws, the exception reaches the caller and nothing is cached for that id.
Do not name `RemoteDocuments` inside the proxy.

checks.title: The real Documents is built exactly once
A repeated id is read from the real one once
A failed read can be retried
Eight simultaneous first reads build and read once
CachedDocuments is a Documents with a factory

hints.text: The proxy stands in for the real thing and adds two decisions: when to create it (first use) and when to skip it (already answered). Callers see only `Documents`.
Keep the `Supplier`, a nullable real `Documents` created under a lock, and a `ConcurrentHashMap<String, String>` cache. `computeIfAbsent` does not store a value if the mapping function throws.
